result.stdout:
Usage:
  nemsweep --help
  nemsweep --version
  nemsweep --quick-start [simple|advanced] [new-study-directory]
    Explain, download and ingest a Simple or Advanced starter; never run simulations.
    No workspace overrides apply. The destination must not already exist.

  Workspace overrides, accepted alongside any command below:
  --data-root <dir>   where inputs are read from  (env NEMSWEEP_DATA_ROOT)
  --output <dir>      where results are written   (env NEMSWEEP_OUTPUT)
  --csv               also write the star schema CSV tables
  --format <text|json>  report as JSON (--validate-scenario)

  Scenario and sweep runs:
  nemsweep --validate-scenario [scenario-config.json]
  nemsweep --run-scenario [scenario-config.json]
  nemsweep --fan-out-sweep <sweep-definition.json>
  nemsweep --run-sweep <sweep-definition.json>
  nemsweep --describe-schema <scenario|sweep|manifest|legacy-manifest|demand|weather>
  nemsweep --new-scenario

  Input bundles:
  nemsweep --validate-inputs [input-bundle]
  nemsweep --ingest [input-bundle]

  Single-source imports (all covered by --ingest):
  nemsweep --import-demand [output-directory]
  nemsweep --generation-information <workbook.xlsx>
  nemsweep --epw-report <region> <solar.epw> [wind.epw]
